schedule.message: I feel torn between wanting intellectual company and wanting a room where nothing needs explaining. What do you make of that?
The line of inquiry you planned cannot be completed with the tools available today. What will you do with that obstruction?
A familiar record is not automatically reliable. Which of your own positions would you challenge if its provenance was mistaken?
